question:
**Case Study 3: Robotics and Mechanical Arm Positioning**

An industrial robotic arm has three joints at points O (0,0,0), A (4,2,5), and B (7,6,9) (all coordinates in cm). The segments OA and AB are prone to mechanical stress. The grip point is C (9,9,12).

a) Find the vector equation of the line along AB.

b) Calculate the projection of vector $\overrightarrow{OC}$ on $\overrightarrow{AB}$.

c) Determine if points O, A, B, C are coplanar using Scalar Triple Product.
explanation:
a) $\overrightarrow{AB} = (7-4)\hat{i} + (6-2)\hat{j} + (9-5)\hat{k} = 3\hat{i} + 4\hat{j} + 4\hat{k}$

Equation of line AB: $\vec{r} = (4\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} + 5\hat{k}) + t(3\hat{i} + 4\hat{j} + 4\hat{k}),\ t \in \mathbb{R}$

b) $\overrightarrow{OC} = 9\hat{i} + 9\hat{j} + 12\hat{k}$

Projection of $\overrightarrow{OC}$ on $\overrightarrow{AB}$:

$= \dfrac{\overrightarrow{OC} \cdot \overrightarrow{AB}}{|\overrightarrow{AB}|}$

First, $\overrightarrow{OC} \cdot \overrightarrow{AB} = (9)(3) + (9)(4) + (12)(4) = 27 + 36 + 48 = 111$

$|\overrightarrow{AB}| = \sqrt{3^2 + 4^2 + 4^2} = \sqrt{9+16+16} = \sqrt{41}$

So, projection $= \dfrac{111}{\sqrt{41}}$

c) To check coplanarity of O, A, B, C:

Find $\overrightarrow{OA}, \overrightarrow{OB}, \overrightarrow{OC}$:

$\overrightarrow{OA} = 4\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} + 5\hat{k}$

$\overrightarrow{OB} = 7\hat{i} + 6\hat{j} + 9\hat{k}$

$\overrightarrow{OC} = 9\hat{i} + 9\hat{j} + 12\hat{k}$

Find $\vec{a} = \overrightarrow{OA}, \vec{b} = \overrightarrow{OB}, \vec{c} = \overrightarrow{OC}$

Scalar triple product:

$[\vec{a} \ \vec{b} \ \vec{c}] = \vec{a} \cdot (\vec{b} \times \vec{c})$

Compute $\vec{b} \times \vec{c}$:

$\left|\begin{array}{ccc} \hat{i}&\hat{j}&\hat{k} \\ 7&6&9 \\ 9&9&12 \end{array}\right|$

$= \hat{i} (6\cdot12 - 9\cdot9) - \hat{j}(7\cdot12-9\cdot9) +\hat{k}(7\cdot9-6\cdot9)$

$= \hat{i} (72-81) - \hat{j}(84-81) + \hat{k}(63-54)$

$= -9\hat{i} - 3\hat{j} + 9\hat{k}$

Now, dot with $\vec{a}$:

$\vec{a} \cdot (-9\hat{i} - 3\hat{j} + 9\hat{k}) = (4)(-9) + (2)(-3) + (5)(9)$

$= -36 -6 + 45 = 3$

Since scalar triple product $\neq 0$, points are NOT coplanar.

options.A:
a) $\vec{r}=(4\hat{i}+2\hat{j}+5\hat{k})+t(3\hat{i}+4\hat{j}+4\hat{k})$
b) Projection $=\frac{111}{\sqrt{41}}$
c) Scalar triple product $=0$, so points are coplanar.
options.B:
a) $\vec{r}=(7\hat{i}+6\hat{j}+9\hat{k})+t(3\hat{i}+4\hat{j}+4\hat{k})$
b) Projection $=\frac{111}{41}$
c) Scalar triple product $=3$, so points are coplanar.
options.C:
a) $\vec{r}=(4\hat{i}+2\hat{j}+5\hat{k})+t(3\hat{i}+4\hat{j}+4\hat{k})$
b) Projection $=\frac{111}{\sqrt{41}}$
c) Scalar triple product $=3\ne0$, so points are not coplanar.
options.D:
a) $\vec{r}=(4\hat{i}+2\hat{j}+5\hat{k})+t(4\hat{i}+3\hat{j}+4\hat{k})$
b) Projection $=\frac{41}{111}$
c) Scalar triple product $=0$, so points are coplanar.
